title: 3 Biggest Mistakes New Drivers Make

script.narration: Stop making these driving mistakes. First, resting your foot on the brake pedal while cruising creates unnecessary wear. Second, ignoring your side mirrors leads to massive blind spots. Finally, accelerating too hard after a stop wastes gas and tires.

Hover your foot near the pedal instead, adjust mirrors to see the horizon, and accelerate smoothly to save your car. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Which of these three mistakes do you catch yourself doing most?

description:
Are you accidentally damaging your car? Avoid these three common driving mistakes that every new driver should know to save money and stay safe on the road.

From brake pedal habits to mirror positioning, these small changes make a big difference. Subscribe for daily driving tips and become a more confident driver today.
